# SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-2.0-only
# This module is copied into an *exactly pinned* ns-3.49 source checkout.
# Protocol C++ files are regenerated by scripts/generate-proto.sh before CMake.
find_package(PkgConfig REQUIRED)
pkg_check_modules(VTNS3ZMQ REQUIRED IMPORTED_TARGET libzmq)
find_package(Protobuf REQUIRED)

if(NOT EXISTS "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/model/generated/gym.pb.cc")
  message(FATAL_ERROR "Generate protobuf code before ns-3 CMake: scripts/generate-proto.sh")
endif()

build_lib(
  LIBNAME vtns3gym
  SOURCE_FILES
    model/bridge.cc
    model/generated/gym.pb.cc
  HEADER_FILES
    model/bridge.h
    model/generated/gym.pb.h
  LIBRARIES_TO_LINK
    ${libcore}
    PkgConfig::VTNS3ZMQ
    protobuf::libprotobuf
)
